paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled “Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob,” illustrates the sentiment analysis accuracy of three models—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis presents the two tweet categories. For each category, three bars are displayed side-by-side: a white bar with no fill for TEXTBLOB, a gray bar with diagonal hatching for VADER, and a solid green bar for ChatGPT. In the “Emoji Tweets” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.3 for TEXTBLOB, 0.4 for VADER, and 0.6 for ChatGPT. In the “Overall Tweet” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.4 for TEXTBLOB, 0.5 for VADER, and 0.6 for ChatGPT. The bars are grouped horizontally by tweet category and sorted in descending order of accuracy from left to right within each group, with ChatGPT consistently showing the highest accuracy in both categories. The chart includes a legend in the lower right corner that identifies each model by its corresponding bar style and color.
